name: itsm-platform
description: ITSM & Helpdesk Platform - monorepo root (FE + BE)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:kill: pkill -f 'node dist/main.js' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'nest start' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'vite' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'concurrently' 2>/dev/null; fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null; fuser -k 3001/tcp 2>/dev/null; echo 'Killed all dev processes'
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
